title: Grateful Dead Live at Wallace Wade Stadium, Duke University on 1971-04-24
lineage: SBD > MR > PCM > CD > EAC > SHN

ai_review.summary: Pristine soundboard captures a high‑energy 4/24/71 Duke show with smoking Hard to Handle, tight Good Lovin', and a standout Not Fade Away → GDTRFB → NFA sequence.
ai_review.review: The recording is an excellent soundboard capture that delivers crystal‑clear instrument separation and a pristine guitar tone. Musically the show is high‑energy and tightly loose, highlighted by Hard to Handle, Good Lovin', Sugar Magnolia (wah‑wah), Sing Me Back Home and an exceptional Not Fade Away → GDTRFB → NFA run.

ai_rating.rationale: Consistently high reviewer scores (average 4.5 stars) with repeated praise for both performance and sound quality.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Crisp, pristine mix with excellent instrument separation; occasional random chatter but no noticeable drop‑outs or muddiness.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Tight yet loose performance; the set feels well‑structured despite a shorter second set due to the multi‑act bill, with seamless transitions and strong song pacing.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Pristine guitar tone noted on Hard to Handle and Sugar Magnolia (wah‑wah), plus beautiful playing on Sing Me Back Home; overall smoking performance.
band_member_comments.Phil: Bass was 'on' especially during the Not Fade Away → GDTRFB → NFA sequence, delivering powerful support throughout.
band_member_comments.Bob: Weir delivers a standout short PITB and solid vocal contributions throughout the show.
